basis: Full22133-byte unified diff read; full7 pre/post files hash-verified and every hunk independently applied forward/reverse as text. Cached rootW verification used, no new remote reads.
checks: The two HTTP handlers retain their full original bodies; profile wraps outer invocation including admission and finally.
Choice authorize/replay/confirm/loadCase/compare/two historical reads/values/save/capture remain in original order with original arguments, guards and catches.
The two stored-result reads remain independent calls; sharing only a diagnostic bucket is not a data cache.
State-provider still clones actual selected case/full namespace; access/authority rechecks remain unchanged.
LocalStore auth/read/currentSnapshots/currentAccessSnapshots wrappers are synchronous and preserve underlying work, file/lifecycle/scope guards and clone operations.
canonicalSfValue and the original new CryptoHasher/update/digest expression remain unchanged inside one synchronous measurement wrapper.

Profile helper uses separate AsyncLocalStorage containing only fixed mode/stage names, ordinal and aggregate counters/timings; no Request,principal,token,payload or business result is retained/logged.
Abort observation is passive; listener removed in finally; no AbortController,timer,retry or timeout change added.
Only diagnostic sink errors are caught; product work results/errors propagate through try/finally. Async wrappers can affect scheduling and overhead, so no timing equivalence is asserted.
No spec/helper/UI/workflow/budget/assertion path is changed; seven historical instrumentation files must be removed/restored before a clean nominal.
interpretation_limits: The counts include returned and thrown work. Handler returned is not itself business success.
Durations are inclusive and overlap; do not sum stages as exclusiveCPU or equate handler time with browserHTTP latency.
Diagnostic J1PASS does not prove stable latency margin, a causal performance improvement or nominal acceptance.
